description: Returns IRIS mirror configuration, membership, and synchronization status. Includes mirror name, member type (Primary/Backup/Async/Not Member), role flags, and overall mirror status. Gracefully reports when mirroring is not configured. No parameters required.

name: iris_mirror_status
title: Mirror Status
